text:
Bea (People Ops): Little heads-up: two external guests dropping by at 3:20 for a quick site-tour. They asked for a temporary badge + a seat by the plant wall. Also  theres a mystery package labeled "fruit samples" at reception that smells suspiciously tropical. Could someone check? :pineapple:
Carlos: Ill be at reception in 5. If its pineapple, I volunteer as tribute. :sweat_smile:
FrontDesk-Bot: Visitor pre-reg received for "Nguyen, Taylor". Badge status: PENDING_PRINT.
Maya: Quick note  badge printer is warming up slowly today (2m delay). Manual fallback: write-on badge + clip works fine.
Bea (People Ops): Good call. If printer still flaky by 3:10 well do clip badges. Can someone move two folding chairs to the plant wall area?
leo: I can grab them from the back room and bring them over now. Also Ill inspect the "fruit samples" package  Im curious.
Courier (DHL): Parcel delivered 14:05  description: "Fruit samples - perishable"  left on reception shelf.
Carlos: Opening the box now (with gloves). Its a tiny crate of sample pineapple tarts from vendor. No suspicious liquids, just crumbs. :yum:
Maya: Pineapple tarts for People Ops? Thats basically corporate morale. Can we put one in the welcome tray?
Bea (People Ops): Please do  one tart in the welcome tray, rest for the office. Also add a small note: "Welcome, guests! — Redwood"
FrontDesk-Bot: Badge printer status: TEST_OK at 15:08.
Bea (People Ops): Printer back online! Printing two temp badges now. If anyone wants to help cut a ribbon for the tarts, meet me at the kitchenette in 2. :cookie:
Carlos: On it. Also FYI the plant-wall chair spot is picture-perfect. Guests will love it.
Maya: Badges printed and guest check-in confirmed at 15:15.
Bea (People Ops): Thanks team. Closing thread unless pineapples plot a takeover. :white_check_mark:
